bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
name=gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1
docker inspect "$name" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo CREATOR_DIAG_CONTAINER_ABSENT; exit 61; }
docker inspect -f 'CREATOR_DIAG_STATE={{.State.Status}} RESTARTS={{.RestartCount}} EXIT={{.State.ExitCode}}' "$name"
docker logs --tail 120 "$name" 2>&1 | python3 -B -c '
import sys,re
lines=sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
out=[]
for line in lines:
 if re.match(r"^CREATOR_[A-Z_]+(?:=[A-Z_]+)?$",line):
  out.append(line)
 elif re.search(r"(?:Error|error|code|reason|cause):",line):
  s=re.sub(r"[/][A-Za-z0-9_./-]{8,}", "PATH_REDACTED",line)
  s=re.sub(r"[0-9]{7,15}:[A-Za-z0-9_-]{30,100}","TOKEN_REDACTED",s)
  s=re.sub(r"postgres(?:ql)?://\S+","DB_URI_REDACTED",s)
  out.append("CREATOR_DIAG_ERROR="+s[:120])
for item in out[-15:]: print(item)
'
echo CREATOR_DIAG_COMPLETE=YES
